hook.text: HACCP can't work in a dirty factory. Prerequisite programs—cleaning, pest control, training.

buildup.text: Prerequisites include sanitation, supplier management, personal hygiene, equipment maintenance, and waste management.

discovery.text: Good Manufacturing Practices (GMPs) are the baseline—the minimum standards every food facility must meet before HACCP applies.

twist.text: Most food safety failures stem from prerequisite breakdowns, not HACCP failures. The foundation cracks before the system.

climax.text: A world-class HACCP plan in a facility with poor sanitation is useless. Prerequisites are not optional—they're essential.

punchline.text: HACCP is the roof. Prerequisites are the foundation. Build both or neither works.

quiz.question: Why are prerequisite programs essential for HACCP?
options: They create the sanitation and hygiene foundation that HACCP depends on
They replace HACCP in small facilities
